name: hold-to-publish
title: Hold to Publish
description: Hold to fill the publish button. A checkmark appears when it completes.
useCases: Before releasing an article, an editor holds the publish button. The app submits the piece to the CMS after the hold completes.
In a teaching workspace, an author starts publishing a lesson, spots a mistake and releases the button before confirming.
task: Hold to fill the publish button. A checkmark appears when it completes.
behavior: duration sets the hold time in milliseconds. Connect publishing to onPublish, invoked after a completed hold.
